architecture_family: low-order ripple plus high-order parallel prefix
observations_used: ripple2_prefix14 strictly dominates prefix16 in area, WNS, and reported power.
ripple4_prefix12 loses substantial timing relative to ripple2_prefix14.
ripple6_prefix10 and ripple10_prefix6 extend the observed low-area timing frontier.
The ripple-prefix tradeoff is non-monotonic, making the missing odd boundary widths important.
hypothesis: Odd ripple widths adjacent to the measured even widths may expose better physical mappings, especially around the high-performance 1-3 bit region and the middle 5-7 bit region.
